map.经济补偿金在当地上年职工平均工资3倍数额以内的部分，免征个人所得税: The part of the compensation within three times the local average annual wage of the previous year is exempt from individual income tax
map.《劳动合同法》第47条（经济补偿）：: Article 47 of the Labor Contract Law (economic compensation):
map.经济补偿按劳动者在本单位工作的年限，每满一年支付一个月工资的标准向劳动者支付。六: Economic compensation is paid at one month's wage for each full year of service with the employer. Six months or more but under a year counts as a year; under six months pays half a month's wage as compensation.
map.《劳动合同法》第40条（N+1）：: Article 40 of the Labor Contract Law (N+1):
map.有下列情形之一的，用人单位提前三十日以书面形式通知劳动者本人或者额外支付劳动者一: In any of the following cases the employer may terminate the contract with 30 days' written notice to the employee or one extra month's wage: (1) the employee is ill or injured other than at work; (2) the employee is incompetent for the work; (3) the objective circumstances on which the contract was based have materially changed.
map.《劳动合同法》第87条（2N）：: Article 87 of the Labor Contract Law (2N):
map.用人单位违反本法规定解除或者终止劳动合同的，应当依照本法第四十七条规定的经济补偿: Where an employer terminates a labor contract in breach of this Law, it shall pay the employee damages of twice the economic compensation standard in Article 47.
map.劳动者月工资高于用人单位所在直辖市、设区的市级人民政府公布的本地区上年度职工月平: Where the monthly wage exceeds three times the average monthly wage of the previous year published by the municipal government of the locality, compensation is paid at three times that average and the years counted are limited to twelve.
map.解除/终止劳动合同时，选择 N、N+1 或 2N 类型测算应付总额。: On termination of a labor contract, choose N, N+1 or 2N to work out the total payable.
map.N 按工作年限计算，满半年不满 1 年按 1 年、不满半年按 0.5 年。: N follows the years of service, with six months or more but under a year counting as one year and under six months as 0.5.
map.高薪者基数与年限双封顶，并提示个税免征额。: For high earners both the base and the years are capped, and the tax-free allowance is flagged.
map.工作 5.5 年、月薪 1 万、N: 5.5 years of service, ¥10,000 a month, N
map.5.5 年 → 满 5 年 + 0.5 年进位为 6 个月，N = 6；经济补偿: 5.5 years gives 5 full years plus 0.5 rounded up to 6 months, so N = 6; compensation = 10000 × 6 = ¥60,000.
map.同条件违法解除：赔偿金 = 10000 × 6 × 2 = 120,000 元（: Unlawful termination on the same facts: damages = 10000 × 6 × 2 = ¥120,000, with no separate N.
map.工作年限怎么算？: How are the years of service counted?
map.按本单位连续工作年限，六个月以上不满一年的按一年，不满六个月的支付半个月工资。: By continuous service with the employer; six months or more but under a year counts as a year, and under six months pays half a month's wage.
map.当地上年职工平均工资 3 倍以内免征；超出部分不并入当年综合所得，单独适用综合所: The part within three times the local average annual wage of the previous year is exempt; the excess is not merged into the year's comprehensive income but taxed separately under the comprehensive rate table.
